description: For any bijection from the naturals to the finite records, the pulled-back trace map is injective and its image is an independent family of cardinality continuum.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.IndependentFamilies.pulledTrace_family (e : ℕ ≃ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.IndependentFamilies.Records) :
  Function.Injective (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.IndependentFamilies.pulledTrace e) ∧
    Lemmatheca.SetTheory.IndependentFamilies.IsIndependent
        (Set.range (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.IndependentFamilies.pulledTrace e)) ∧
      Cardinal.mk ↑(Set.range (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.IndependentFamilies.pulledTrace e)) = Cardinal.continuum
